segments.name: Digital services
segments.description: Provides digital content and MCN services, custom software development, and AI- and blockchain-based digital authentication services to individual and corporate clients.
segments.evidence: Our services primarily consist of three core areas: (1) digital content and MCN services, (2) software development services, and (3) digital authentication services.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay upfront, non-refundable fees for tiered digital service packages, with basic service revenue recognized ratably over the contract term and value-added services recognized upon acceptance.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company recognizes revenues from basic services ratably over the contract term beginning on the commencement date of each contract.

changes.text: In 2025 the company pivoted from its legacy WiFi/SaaS networking business to a digital service provider model, launching customized software services in July 2025.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, we formally launched customized software services.

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired Japanese digital authentication firm HGK, adding AI and blockchain authentication services to its portfolio.
changes.evidence: On November 30, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Houren-Geiju Kabushikikaisha ("HGK"), a Japanese technology company specializing in digital authentication services for art collections.

changes.text: In 2023 the company's exclusive global license to sell consumer networking products under the Motorola brand ended.
changes.evidence: During this period, we held the exclusive global license to design, manufacture, and sell consumer networking products under the Motorola brand until 2023.
